newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL STAY TOP WITH 1-0 WIN AT SPORTING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL STAY TOP WITH 1-0 WIN AT SPORTING.

text.p: Real Madrid ensured they will start next weekend's old firm clash with Barcelona as leaders of the Spanish first division by beating Sporting Gijon 1-0 away on Saturday.

With 35 points from 15 games, Real go four clear of Barcelona, who play struggling Extremadura on Monday. Champions Atletico Madrid are a further four points back in fourth after their 1-0 home victory over Racing Santander.
Captain Fernando Hierro clinched the victory for Real in the 19th minute, rising well to head home a corner from Brazilian defender Roberto Carlos.
Real goalkeeper Bodo Illgner was in fine form as Sporting piled on the pressure, but the visitors upped their game and were able to hold on in the second half of a rain-soaked match.
A solitary Juan Eduardo Esnaider goal midway through the first half was enough to hand Atletico provisional fourth place, one point ahead of Real Betis who play on Sunday.
Another Esnaider goal was disallowed and Kiko Narvaez hit the post twice as Atletico had the best of an otherwise dull game.
In their last six matches Radomir Antic's side have recovered from a poor start by clocking up five wins and one draw against Barcelona.
